dedupe_keys.name: icao api data service 2 0 reference data safety indicators state registries usoap metrics

description: The ICAO API Data Service 2.0 gives programmatic access to ICAO reference data, aviation safety indicators, State registry information and implementation metrics of the Universal Safety Oversight Audit Programme (USOAP) through secure APIs. It is run by the International Civil Aviation Organization, the UN agency for civil aviation, and lists its services with endpoints and parameters on the service page. Coverage is global, by State. Access needs a registration with name, organisation and business email for an API key, which comes with free trial calls, and more calls are available by purchasing booster packs; full dataset downloads and enterprise access are arranged with the API team, under ICAO terms and conditions. Caveats: the free tier is limited to trial calls, and the catalogue of services is only visible through the service interface. It supports context layers on airports and State safety oversight for aviation risk and resilience analysis. It complements the OpenSky Network flight data and is related to the ACI World airport traffic statistics.
name: ICAO API Data Service 2.0 (reference data, safety indicators, State registries, USOAP metrics)
